content: SQLite FTS5 is NOT typo-tolerant by default (prefix matching only). The trigram tokenizer (FTS5 built-in since 3.34) enables fast indexed substring/LIKE matching and speeds up fuzzy-ish substring queries 100x vs linear scan, but for true typo tolerance combine FTS5 (candidate retrieval) with an edit-distance re-ranker (e.g. RapidFuzz-equivalent) for final scoring. This hybrid retrieval+rerank pattern scales to millions of rows.
